g.text: Overlap needs a compute resource budget
Separate workload cohorts; every dot is one complete repeat. DeepGEMM SM budget changes; communication stays at 132 CTAs.
All policies use host window 2. Whole has one full-capacity slot; Request has two. All tails retained; startup excluded; no full-serving claim.
